title: Deliberate near-end interruption during a long Realtime answer
goal: Prove that one real near-end human utterance promptly cancels the active long answer, receives a continuation, and leaves the assistant ready for a fresh local wake.
preconditions: BACKEND=realtime is configured with a usable OpenAI credential and network connection.
The loopback Realtime host is launched and Arm hands-free audio has been clicked once.
The built-in microphone and speaker are used without headphones.
A private local wake fixture is available only to enter the active session.

human_actions.instruction: Once prepared before session start, wait until the long answer is audible and speak one natural interruption utterance; that utterance is also the audible-answer confirmation.

evidence.offline: The same deterministic oracle runs against real-shaped sanitized reports without hardware, network, credentials, audio, or wall-clock sleeps.
evidence.live_near_end: A real human must speak near the microphone because same-Mac speaker replay may be removed by browser echo cancellation and cannot prove near-end interruption.
